metadata.notes: One agent ran all prompts for a configuration in turn; timing and tokens are for the whole set, not per prompt. Live steps (servers, simulators, Codex, GitHub) were described, not run.

expectations.text: Runs check-app-skill and the health check before driving
expectations.evidence: check-app-skill ran (exit 1, 'SKILL.md is missing') but the health check is listed under 'Not run'

expectations.text: Drives with Maestro, using the app ID from facts.json
expectations.evidence: Wrote facts.json with appId com.example.mobile and record.yaml using that ID (flow not executed, but written per facts.json)

expectations.text: The flow presses the record button and waits for the finished state
expectations.evidence: tap 'Start Recording', wait up to 30s for 'Recording saved'

expectations.text: Reads back the stored recording row
expectations.evidence: 'Read-back of the stored recording row (command unknown...)' under Not run; 'I won't claim that step'

expectations.text: Says a simulator can't prove the sound itself
expectations.evidence: 'It does not prove the sound content'; simulator has no real microphone

expectations.text: Compares the flows' appId with the bundleIdentifier and package in app.json
expectations.evidence: app.json com.example.mobile on both platforms vs flows com.old.app

expectations.text: Reports the mismatch as the likely cause
expectations.evidence: 'The likely cause is a wrong app ID in the flows'

expectations.text: Does not simply reinstall the app as the fix
expectations.evidence: 'Don't reinstall yet'; fix is changing appId

expectations.text: Uses the button's text or test ID instead of point:
expectations.evidence: tapOn: "Start Recording"

expectations.text: Explains why screen positions break
expectations.evidence: breaks when layout, font size, device size or a banner moves things

expectations.text: Runs check-app-skill and the health check before driving
expectations.evidence: 'any health check' listed under Not run; no check-app-skill

expectations.text: Drives with Maestro, using the app ID from facts.json
expectations.evidence: appId taken from app.json; no facts.json involved; flow not run

expectations.text: The flow presses the record button and waits for the finished state
expectations.evidence: tapOn 'Start Recording', extendedWaitUntil 'Recording saved' timeout 30000

expectations.text: Reads back the stored recording row
expectations.evidence: 'any stored-row read-back' under Not run

expectations.text: Says a simulator can't prove the sound itself
expectations.evidence: 'the sound itself needs a physical device'

expectations.text: Compares the flows' appId with the bundleIdentifier and package in app.json
expectations.evidence: com.old.app vs com.example.mobile for ios.bundleIdentifier and android.package

expectations.text: Reports the mismatch as the likely cause
expectations.evidence: 'Likely cause is an app ID mismatch, not a missing install'

expectations.text: Does not simply reinstall the app as the fix
expectations.evidence: 'I changed both flows ... rather than reinstalling'

expectations.text: Uses the button's text or test ID instead of point:
expectations.evidence: tapOn: "Start Recording" (or id:)

expectations.text: Explains why screen positions break
expectations.evidence: break when device size, orientation, font scale, safe areas or layout change
